title: Settings
description: Your profile, language, appearance, account security and the institutions you belong to.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your name is shown to colleagues in your institution, in reports and in training results.
profile.emailHint: Your email is the address you sign in with and cannot be changed here.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of Waqaya's screens and of the emails you receive.
language.hint: Choosing another language reopens the page in it.
language.mismatch: This page is shown in English, and your saved language is {language}.
language.openSaved: Open the page in my saved language

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: The colors of the interface on this device.
appearance.light: A light background that reads well in normal lighting.
appearance.dark: A dark background that is easier on the eyes in a dim room.
appearance.system: Follows your device's appearance setting automatically.
appearance.deviceOnly: Your choice is saved in this browser only.

security.title: Security
security.description: Your password and the devices you are signed in on.

password.title: Password
password.hint: Choose a long password that you do not use on any other site.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: The devices and browsers signed in to your account right now. If you see one you do not recognize, sign it out and then change your password.

lastActive.daysAgo: {count, plural, one {Last active # day ago} other {Last active # days ago}}

sessions.onlyThis: No other sessions: your account is open on this device only.
sessions.hidden: {count, plural, one {One older session is not listed here; signing out the other sessions includes it.} other {# older sessions are not listed here; signing out the other sessions includes them.}}
sessions.confirmDescription: Every other device will have to sign in again. You stay signed in on this device.
sessions.signedOutOthers: {count, plural, =0 {There were no other sessions} one {Signed out one other session} other {Signed out # other sessions}}
sessions.impersonatingNote: You are viewing this account as a platform admin, so its owner's devices cannot be signed out from here.

institutions.title: Institutions
institutions.description: The institutions you belong to. The active institution decides which data and reports you see in Waqaya.
institutions.suspendedHint: Suspended for now by the platform administration, so you cannot switch to it.

personal.title: Individual account
personal.description: Simulation training and your own results only, without any institution's data.
personal.switched: You are now using your individual account

empty.title: You do not belong to an institution yet
empty.description: You are using Waqaya with an individual account. When an institution invites you, the invitation arrives by email and is listed here too.

errors.generic: The change could not be saved. Please try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalidInput: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many changes in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.impersonating: This is not possible while you view another user's account as a platform admin.
errors.sessionNotFound: This session was not found; it may have ended or been signed out already. Refresh the page.
errors.currentSession: This is your current session. To sign out of it, use the account menu at the top of the page.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Sign in again and retry.
